notes: VS-28 is presentation, accessibility and runtime-shell work only; it does not change domain, API, persistence, authentication/session, provider or recommendation behavior.
The certified five-tab route names, order and destination meaning remain unchanged under DEC-09; structural navigation alignment remains deferred.
Safe-area geometry derives from actual device insets, viewport width and font scale rather than device-name checks or fixed notch/home-indicator constants.
Top-level mobile navigation delegates to Expo Router NativeTabs; iOS uses system SF Symbols while Android retains Atlas icon fallbacks.
Liquid Glass is limited to approved floating/structural chrome with a complete solid Atlas fallback for unsupported conditions, Reduce Transparency and Android.
Motion is restrained, interruptible and reduced-motion aware; it must never delay content or block navigation.
No production release, production enablement, EAS build/submit/OTA or deployment is authorized.
